Container.Name: tastearr
Container.Overview: Tastearr learns your anime taste from your Sonarr library, Plex/Jellyfin watch history and a quick quiz, then recommends each new season's shows and adds the ones you pick to Sonarr. Optional phone alerts (ntfy, Gotify, Discord) for new episodes and new-season picks.

Config.Name: Appdata (read-only, for auto-detect)
Config.Description: Optional. Lets Tastearr read Sonarr/Radarr API keys and the Plex token so setup is one click.

Config.Name: Docker socket (read-only, for auto-detect)
Config.Description: Optional. Lets auto-detect find your containers' addresses. Remove if you'd rather not share it.

Config.Name: Host IP
Config.Description: Optional. Your server's LAN IP, used by auto-detect for apps on bridge networking.
